name: Low-Carb Turkey and Green Bean Cheddar Casserole
why: Oven-baked turkey + green bean + cheddar casserole, mix-and-bake so it scales cleanly to 14 servings by weight. Published nutrition clears the band at 416 cal / 12.5g total carbs (9g net) / 23.6g protein per serving; structurally low-carb (whole-muscle turkey + green beans + cheese + mayo, no rice/pasta/potato). Turkey->turkey-breast, green beans->frozen-green-beans, cheddar, mayonnaise, garlic, walnuts all have board homes; cranberry-sauce and goat-cheese are genuinely absent from the board and are flagged as unmapped to exercise the pricer lane. Confidence: HIGH on macros (read from label). Caveats: cal 416 sits near the 400 floor so computed macros could drift low - but the optional 1/2 cup walnuts (excluded from the published number) would push it toward ~470 and more central; nutrition assumes SUGAR-FREE cranberry sauce, so a regular cranberry-sauce board row would inflate carbs/sugar and must be sourced sugar-free.
